documentation.title: Expenses App User Guide
documentation.subtitle: Learn how to use all features of the Expenses application to manage your finances effectively
documentation.intro: Welcome to the Expenses application! This guide will help you understand how to use all the features available in the application. Whether you're tracking expenses, monitoring income, analyzing your spending patterns, or setting up budgets, this guide has you covered.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.intro: Before you can start using the application, you need to create an account and log in:
steps: Click the "Sign Up" button on the home page.
Fill in your details in the registration form and submit.
Once registered, log in with your credentials.
After logging in, you'll be taken to the dashboard where you can start using the application.

expenses.title: Tracking Expenses
expenses.description: Record and categorize your daily expenses to understand where your money goes.
addSteps: Fill in the expense details (amount, date, category, description)
manageSteps: Add new categories or edit existing ones
Categories help you organize and analyze your spending

income.title: Monitoring Income
income.description: Keep track of all your income sources and see your earnings over time.
addSteps: Fill in the income details (amount, date, category, description)
manageSteps: Add new categories or edit existing ones
Categories help you track different income sources

statistics.title: Visualizing Data
statistics.description: View detailed charts and statistics to gain insights into your financial habits.
viewSteps: View summary charts showing your income vs. expenses
See breakdowns of expenses by category
Track your spending trends over time
viewsSteps: Click on "Monthly View" to see data for specific months
Click on "Yearly View" to see annual summaries
Use the date selectors to navigate between different time periods

budget.title: Budget Management
budget.description: Create custom budgets tailored to your financial goals and lifestyle.
setupSteps: Click "Create Budget" to set up a new budget
Set budget amounts for different expense categories
Specify the time period for your budget (monthly, quarterly, etc.)
monitorSteps: View your budget progress on the Budget page
See visual indicators of how your spending compares to your budget
Get alerts when you're approaching or exceeding budget limits

profile.title: Profile Management
profile.description: Manage your account settings and customize your experience.
manageSteps: Create, edit, or delete expense and income categories
Customize categories to match your financial needs

regularUpdates.title: Regular Updates:
regularUpdates.text: Enter your expenses and income regularly to maintain accurate records.

detailedDescriptions.title: Detailed Descriptions:
detailedDescriptions.text: Add detailed descriptions to your transactions to help you remember what they were for.

useCategories.title: Use Categories Effectively:
useCategories.text: Create specific categories that match your spending habits for better analysis.

reviewStatistics.title: Review Statistics Regularly:
reviewStatistics.text: Check your statistics monthly to identify spending patterns and areas for improvement.

realisticBudgets.title: Realistic Budgets:
realisticBudgets.text: Set realistic budget goals based on your actual income and necessary expenses.

cta.title: Ready to start managing your finances?
cta.subtitle: Now that you understand how to use the application, it's time to take control of your financial future.
